Settings

Which lessons are in play is set with the Lessons bar under the tabs. It applies to Draw, Sentences, Read and Pop quiz together.

Sync between devices with a GitHub Gist

Keeps one copy of your progress in a secret Gist on your GitHub account, so phone and PC share it. Create a fine-grained token at github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens, with only the Gists: read and write permission, and paste it here. The token stays in this browser only.

Backup / move progress to another device

Progress saves automatically here, and syncs to your account when opened through Claude. For a manual copy: export, paste into the other device, import.

⚡ Reading challenge
